text:
Key decisions
- Browser uploads straight to S3 in
  chunks: resumable on bad mobile data
- S3 event -> queue; jobs keyed by
  file + stage, safe to retry
- Transcode and transcribe in parallel
- Word timestamps make every quote
  a playable clip
- Redact PII before analysis; keep raw
  media in the customer's region
